content.text:
## Verdict

Today, **formal PROP creation is Worker-side** (`submitLegislationItem`), not Ava. In-game `/proposal` already charges 64G then **Grok-rewrites + publishes immediately**. There is **no D1 idea queue** — you need a new migration. Ava’s existing “catch-up” is Discord chat/jobs, not pending citizen ideas.

---

### 1. Ava bot entrypoints (`Web Files/rootmc-ava/`)

| Piece | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Supervisor | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/index.mjs` | Spawns `server.mjs` + `poller.mjs` |
| Live pipeline | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/pipeline.mjs` | Message handling; wake catch-up of **missed Discord chat**; feature → plan/job, not PROP |
| Gateway | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/gateway.mjs` | Live Discord events (`AVA_TRANSPORT=both`) |
| REST poller | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/poller.mjs` | Boot watermark, reactions, sleep auto-wake, includes proposal forum threads in watch |
| Poll watcher | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/pollWatcher.mjs` | Seeds ✅/❌/➖; auto-votes; stage-only jobs on gate |
| Governance client | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/governanceClient.mjs` | **GET** polls/council/power; **POST** votes via `X-RootMC-Dev-Key` — **no create-proposal API** |
| Jobs | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/jobQueue.mjs` + `pendingTasks.mjs` | Local JSON job queue / self-audit — not D1 legislation |
| Sleep / catch-up | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/sleepMode.mjs` | Digests missed channel messages on wake |
| Offline | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/offlineNotes.mjs` | Posts “brain offline” notes — no proposal pickup |
| Config channels | `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/config.mjs` | `AVA_CHANNELS.proposals` = `1526664180491358419` |

**One-off / manual “catch-up” scripts** (create Discord forum threads directly — **bypass D1 / `submitLegislationItem`**):

- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/catchup-snappy.mjs`
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/catchup-standing.mjs`
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/full-update-post.mjs`
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/post-catchup-updates.mjs`
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/post-proposal.mjs` (archived stub)

Ava **never** calls `/api/rootmc/ingame-proposal` or `submitLegislationItem`. Formalization today is Worker Grok in `rootmc-ingame-proposal.ts`.

---

### 2. D1 queue — **new migration needed**

Existing tables (not an idea queue):

- `rootmc_legislation_items` — **already formal** (`pending` = published, awaiting weekly compile)  
  Schema: `Web Files/rootmc-api/migrations/0124_rootmc_legislature.sql` (+ `0125` thread, `0126` synthesis)
- `rootmc_community_proposals` — vote/poll rows (legislation polls reuse PROP id)

Latest MANIFEST ends at `0162_…` under `Web Files/rootmc-api/migrations/MANIFEST.txt` (files in `rootrecord-api-account/migrations/`). Next would be **`0163_rootmc_proposal_idea_queue.sql`** (or similar).

---

### 3. Create entry points to disable / redirect

All formal creates funnel to `submitLegislationItem` in  
`D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\rootmc-legislature.ts` (lines ~237–334): INSERT + forum thread + `openCitizenProposalPoll`.

| Entry | Path | Action |
|---|---|---|
| **Keep (queue only)** | In-game → `CloudApiClient.submitIngameProposal` → `POST /api/rootmc/ingame-proposal` | `Plugin Building/Minecraft/.../ProposalCommand.java` · `CloudApiClient.java` · `rootmc-ingame-proposal.ts` |
| **Disable** | Web `POST /api/governance/proposals` | `rootmc-governance-web.ts` ~458–493 · UI `rootmc-web/public/governance/submit/index.html` (+ `governance.js`) |
| **Disable** | Discord `/proposal submit` + `/proposals submit` | `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` `handleProposalSlashCommand` ~927–940 · registered in `discord-register-rootmc-commands.mjs` · routed in `discord-rootmc-bot.ts` ~635 |
| **Staff-only (keep separate)** | `/proposal create` | Same slash handler → `createCommunityProposal` (staff community polls, not citizen legislature) |
| **Do not use for citizen path** | Ava scripts that `POST .../channels/{proposals}/threads` | Manual forum posts without D1 |

Also update copy that still points at web/Discord submit: constitution wiki, council pages, `listLegislationSummary` strings in `rootmc-legislature.ts`, refresh pins in `refresh-discord-governance-channels.mjs`.

---

### 4. Discord proposal threads & who can talk

**Create:** `createForumPostThread` in `discord-rootmc-api.ts` → RootMC bot opens a forum post on `DISCORD_ROOTMC_PROPOSALS_CHANNEL_ID`. Starter message invites discussion; thread id stored on `rootmc_legislation_items.discord_thread_id`.

**Discuss after create:**

- Slash: `/proposal discuss id:…` returns `<#threadId>` (`rootmc-community-proposals.ts` ~897–924)
- Synthesis: `rootmc-proposal-synthesis.ts` reads non-bot thread messages → Grok → `synthesized_description`

**Permissions (setup script):**  
`setup-discord-proposals-channel.mjs` — `@everyone` view/read; **Linked** (`1516396491973984256`) + **Council** view/read/attach; **Staff** also SEND. Linked role = verified/linked players. Discussion is intended **in each proposal thread** (not inventing new top-level posts). Parent channel SEND is locked for @everyone so randoms don’t spam the forum root — threads inherit linked/staff send-in-thread behavior on the live guild (confirm SEND_IN_THREADS on Linked if you tighten this).

**Votes:** separate `#voting` poll via `openCitizenProposalPoll` → `createCommunityProposal(..., kind: "legislation", pollChannel: "voting")`. Ava watches polls; text votes via workstation key.

---

### 5. Recommended architecture

**Split “idea” vs “formal PROP”.**

```
In-game /proposal (64G)
  → POST /api/rootmc/ingame-proposal
  → INSERT idea_queue (raw text, player, fee meta)  [NO Grok, NO forum, NO poll]
  → reply: "Queued for Ava · IDEA-…"

Ava (online / wake / boot)
  → GET pending ideas (workstation auth)
  → Grok formalize in Ava voice (or call Worker formalize endpoint)
  → POST formalize → submitLegislationItem (created_by = player Discord; clerk note = Ava)
  → mark idea formalized

Ava offline
  → queue accumulates ("official list" = D1 + optional GET for site/status)
  → on wake: same poll as Discord catch-up (extend poller/pipeline wake path)
```

**Suggested table `rootmc_proposal_ideas`:**

| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `id` | `IDEA-…` or uuid |
| `minecraft_uuid`, `minecraft_username` | Submitter |
| `discord_user_id` | Resolved at submit (already required) |
| `raw_message` | Player free text |
| `fee_g`, `fee_transfer_id?` | Audit / refunds |
| `status` | `queued` \| `formalizing` \| `formalized` \| `rejected` \| `refunded` |
| `legislation_item_id` | PROP id once created |
| `ava_title`, `ava_description`, `category` | Optional draft cache |
| `error_detail` | Last failure |
| `created_at`, `formalized_at`, `claimed_by`, `claimed_at` | Queue + lease |

**API surface:**

1. `POST /api/rootmc/ingame-proposal` — enqueue only; refund still on validation fail.
2. `GET /api/governance/proposal-ideas?status=queued` — workstation/`X-RootMC-Dev-Key` (Ava pulls).
3. `POST /api/governance/proposal-ideas/:id/formalize` — Ava (or Worker-on-behalf-of-Ava) runs rewrite + `submitLegislationItem`, marks idea done. Prefer **Ava pulls** so offline Ava doesn’t miss push; poll every N min + on boot/wake in `poller.mjs` / wake block in `pipeline.mjs`.

**Disable web/Discord submit** with message: use in-game `/proposal` (64G); ideas appear after Ava formalizes.

**Discussion unchanged:** once PROP exists, verified/linked post in the forum thread; voting unchanged.

**Why not reuse `rootmc_legislation_items.status`?** `pending` already means “public, awaiting compile.” Mixing “unpublished idea” would break weekly compile, synthesis, and site lists.

**Ava catch-up hook:** extend existing wake/boot catch-up (same place as chat digest) to call `processPendingProposalIdeas()` — do not rely only on one-off `scripts/catchup-*.mjs`.
